canvas_subtitle: Computer Science Student - IUT2 Université Grenoble Alpes
experience_project1_desc: Used SQL queries to extract, clean, and structure data from a database. The information was then exported to CSV format, resulting in the creation of a summary report presenting the results obtained and the key insights derived from the analysis. This project demonstrates skills in database management, data analysis, and report writing.
experience_project2_desc: Development of a Java-based chatbot capable of intelligently responding to user questions. The program analyzes incoming messages and generates suitable responses based on the structure of the requests. This project applies skills in object-oriented programming and algorithmic logic.
experience_project3_desc: Online quiz developed using the Flask framework in Python, generating a personalized result based on user answers. This project implements the creation of web interfaces, form processing, and server-side business logic.
about_pc_desc: One of my most challenging projects was designing and building my own computer. From the comparative research of components (CPU, GPU, RAM) to the final assembly, I ensured the optimization of airflow and cable management. This experience forged my skills in problem-solving and technical project management.
about_sport_desc: Swimming and triathlon instilled rigor and perseverance in me from an early age. Today, I cultivate this balance through weightlifting and running. For me, sport is much more than a physical activity: it is an essential pillar for maintaining a mind-body balance and a daily discipline.
about_culture_desc: Evolving in a bilingual French-English environment since childhood, I navigate with ease between these two cultures. This linguistic duality, reinforced by my family ties abroad, brings me an open, diverse vision of the world and a great adaptability in international contexts.
about_travel_desc: Passionate about discovery, I have traveled across the Alpine massifs for skiing and explored the richness of French regions, from Brittany to the Pyrenees. Each trip is an opportunity to immerse myself in local traditions and to marvel at the diversity of landscapes, constantly fueling my curiosity.
about_worlds_desc: Driven by a passion for storytelling, I love exploring the vast richness of fictional universes across films, video games, manga, and light novels. I am particularly fascinated by the fantasy genre and the subtle artistry authors use to draw from our world's diverse cultures, traditions, and societal lifestyles, adapting them to fit into the unique, self-contained worlds of their own creation. This process goes far beyond simple inspiration; it is a profound reimagining where real-world cultural structures, ancient mythologies, and historical pantheons blend seamlessly together. Whether an author is reinventing ancestral legends or fusing distinct customs from opposite sides of the globe, every piece of media becomes a captivating landscape to analyze. Decoding these unique influences and marveling at the sheer coherence of these hybrid microcosms constantly fuels my own curiosity, analytical mindset, and global perspective.
section_cv_desc: For a more detailed view of my skills and experience, I invite you to consult my CV below.
2nd_p1_desc_p1: This project involved architecting a speedy, Java-based chatbot engineered to parse and respond to natural language queries. To maximize efficiency, I implemented a custom lookup index to ensure an instantaneous word search. Furthermore, to overcome vocabulary barriers, the backend incorporates an integrated thesaurus system that synchronizes words based on semantic meaning, allowing the chatbot to accurately capture user intent even when different phrasing is used.
2nd_p1_desc_p2: At the core of its algorithmic logic is a sophisticated sentence 'calculator' designed to analyze the syntax and structural pattern of incoming questions. This allows the bot to dynamically formulate responses that align with the user's grammatical order for a more natural conversational flow. To showcase the application, our team developed a dedicated frontend interface and deployed the entire system via a locally hosted web server, connecting the Java logic with a clean UI.
2nd_p2_desc_p1: This project involved developing an interactive personality quiz using the Flask framework in Python, engineered to determine a personalized Pokémon elemental type for each user based on their inputs. The backend dynamically parses a structured JSON file containing all questions, answers, and strategic point allocations. These points are mapped directly to specific indices within a tracking array allocated to each Pokémon type, ensuring clean data handling during form processing.
2nd_p2_desc_p2: To achieve absolute algorithmic fairness, I implemented a mathematical readjustment layer at the final evaluation phase. This calculation normalizes the maximum possible score for every single category, ensuring that all Pokémon types have an mathematically equal opportunity to be selected, neutralizing any questionnaire bias for a genuinely tailored, personalized result. This project showcases proficiency in server-side routing, JSON parsing, and algorithmic data normalization.
2nd_p3_desc_p1: This project involved refining massive nutritional datasets extracted from the global OpenFoodFacts database, specifically focusing on the processed meat sector in France. Utilizing targeted SQL queries, I extracted, structured, and engineered raw data while aggressively filtering out aberrant data points and corrupted anomalies. This critical data-cleansing phase transformed an unstable public dataset into a reliable foundation for statistical analysis.
2nd_p3_desc_p2: Once structured, the data was exported into R to build comprehensive statistical graphs and map out macro-nutritional trends. The analysis deep-dived into the specific variables that dictate food health grades, identifying exactly which components, such as excessive grease, sugars, and sodium will drag a product's grade down, versus positive drivers like high protein content. The final deliverables culminated in an executive summary report detailing key market insights and processing standards.
